verdict.rationale: Canva's official docs and hosted MCP server explicitly support natural-language design generation and editing: 'Design generation: Create designs programmatically from text descriptions and specifications' and 'Design editing: Apply targeted modifications to existing designs through natural language commands,' with a live, runtime-verified MCP endpoint (mcp.canva.com) confirming this is a real, working integration rather than just a doc claim. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reviews/examples of actual generated mockups and no first-party demonstration of output quality or fidelity.
